plugins.name: wakeflow
plugins.description: A disciplined control loop for multi-window agent work across a tmux-resident fleet of Claude Code sessions: a Controller window claims requirement packages, plans task packages, prepares deliveries, imports immutable target results, obtains independent Test validation and reviews the evidence before completing and archiving a Demand. Explicit on-disk state roots keep every step auditable; Agents perform the host actions, Wakeflow owns the content and the verification.
